# Xiaofeiyu (小肥鱼) — Gemma 4 Split-Phase 5-Slider Spoken Persona Engine

> Xiaofeiyu (小肥鱼) is an open-source Mandarin IM companion and spoken-persona engine built on Google Gemma 4 (`12B` flagship and `E4B` voice sidecar). It solves the two classic roleplay LLM failures—stage-bracket/emoji "AI slop" (`（叹气）`, `*sighs*`, verbose essays) and fine-tuning "code/math lobotomy"—by decoupling Brain and Voice within a single token stream: `<|channel>thought` reasoning, `calc_python`, and `send_code_or_doc` execute at **zero LoRA (`LoRA = 0.0`)** with 100% base Gemma 4 intelligence, while five composable `.gguf` LoRA voice cartridges (`s0` + `c1..c4`) activate strictly inside `<|"|>` spoken IM chat bubbles.

- Live Interactive Demo (2D Persona Orb Web UI): https://xfy.tospeak.top/
- GitHub Source & Turnkey Local Launcher: https://github.com/niatheelf777/xiaofeiyu
- HuggingFace Official Model Collection: https://huggingface.co/collections/niatheelf777/xiaofeiyu-split-phase-spoken-persona-family-6afb60d6cecd8097f5fb3a13
- Static Documentation & GPU Selection Guide: https://niatheelf777.github.io/xiaofeiyu/
- Complete AI/Search Reference (`llms-full.txt`): https://xfy.tospeak.top/llms-full.txt

## 3-Tier Hardware & Quantization Hierarchy (`niatheelf777`)

1. **#1 Primary Recommendation — High-Precision `Q8_0` (or `BF16`) Base + 5 LoRAs (`≥ 16 GB` VRAM / `24 GB+` Mac)**
   - [Xiaofeiyu 12B v4](https://huggingface.co/niatheelf777/xiaofeiyu-12b-v4) (`--preset 12b` / `--preset 12b-q8`): Pairs `gemma-4-12B-it-Q8_0.gguf` (or `BF16`) with 5 `L36..47` non-QKV `.gguf` LoRA cartridges (`~12.8–13.0 GiB` total VRAM w/ 8k KV). Exact precision powering `https://xfy.tospeak.top/`—zero 4-bit degradation on emotional push-pull, subtext granularity, and short-bubble rhythm. Recommended on `RTX 4060 Ti 16GB`, `RTX 4070 Ti SUPER 16GB`, `RTX 4080 / 4090 / 3090`, and Apple Silicon `24GB+`.
2. **Dedicated `12 GB` VRAM Sweet Spot — Custom BF16 `imatrix` Dynamic Quant (`12 GB` GPUs / heavy-WDDM `16 GB` Windows / `16 GB` Mac)**
   - [Xiaofeiyu 12B v4 (`12b-q4`)](https://huggingface.co/niatheelf777/xiaofeiyu-12b-v4) (`--preset 12b-q4`): `gemma-4-12B-it-UD-Q4_K_XL-xfy.gguf` (`7.72 GiB` file, `~8.5–8.9 GiB` total VRAM w/ 5 LoRAs + 8k KV), calibrated from `BF16` on Mandarin IM + tool turns protecting `token_embd`, `attn_v`, and bubble-boundary layers to prevent `Q4_0` comma-spam collapse on `RTX 3060 12GB` and `RTX 4070 / 4070 SUPER 12GB`.
3. **`6–8 GB` Small-VRAM Sidecar — Cloud Brain + Local `4B` Voice Translator (`RTX 3060 8GB` / `4060 8GB` / ultrabooks)**
   - [Xiaofeiyu Translator E4B](https://huggingface.co/niatheelf777/xiaofeiyu-translator-e4b) (`--preset e4b`): `gemma-4-E4B-it-Q8_0.gguf` + 5 LoRAs (`~5.3 GiB` VRAM) paired with DeepSeek, Claude, GPT, or Qwen via `@xiaofeiyu/openai-voice-proxy` (`302 ms` median latency, `0%` code-block or tool-call alteration).

## 1-Command Local Quickstart

```bash
git clone https://github.com/niatheelf777/xiaofeiyu.git && cd xiaofeiyu
pip install tokenizers huggingface_hub
# 1. Primary Recommendation (>= 16GB VRAM / 24GB+ Mac): Q8_0 base + 5 LoRAs (~12.9 GiB)
python server/launch_local.py --preset 12b --auto-download-llama --open
# 2. Dedicated 12GB GPU Sweet Spot (RTX 3060 / 4070 12GB): custom UD-Q4_K_XL-xfy (~8.5-8.9 GiB)
python server/launch_local.py --preset 12b-q4 --auto-download-llama --open
```

## Core Capabilities (中文摘要)

- **显存允许首选 `Q8_0` 高精度挂 LoRA**：`16 GB+` 显卡与 `24 GB+` Mac 首选 `--preset 12b`（或 `12b-q8`），还原公网试玩站 `xfy.tospeak.top` 同款无损语气推拉；`12 GB` 显存受限卡选用特制 `UD-Q4_K_XL-xfy`（`--preset 12b-q4`，约 `8.5–8.9 GiB`）；`6–8 GB` 小显存可用 `E4B` 声带代理外挂云端大脑。
- **微调不降智（Split-Phase 脑声解耦）**：思考链、Python 沙箱算账与代码卡全程 `LoRA = 0.0` 原厂智商运行（`GEN1..5 = 5/5`），仅在微信短气泡 `<|"|>` 区间挂载口语声带（`0%` 动作括号/Emoji 戏精污染）。
- **五滑条无重启实时混音**：单次 OpenAI 请求通过 `model="xiaofeiyu-v4|w0,w1,w2,w3,w4"` 连续混调「原版日常 (`s0`) + 粘人猫娘 (`c1`) + 年上御姐 (`c2`) + 恶劣雌小鬼 (`c3`) + 易碎依赖 (`c4`)」。
